newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex price target raised.

text.p: Santander Investment said it has increased its price target for Mexican telephone company Telefonos de Mexico SA to $60 per ADR from $50 per ADR.
-- It said that while the telecom sector has seen significant price gains to date it believes there are fundamental reasons for remaining positive on Telmex shares.
-- "We believe that Telmex will surprise in terms of its ability to sustain itself in a competitive market," analysts Leslie Marcus and Lars Schonander wrote.

-- "The shares remain undervalued. We reiterate our buy rating and raise our 12-month price target to US$60 per ADR from US$50, for a 24 percent upside from current levels versus the IPC's expected return of 11 percent," they wrote.
-- Telmex was off 3/8 at 47-3/4 in early trade Monday.
